Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

_TUVTR_WU_UXVN_Y
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: _TUVTR_WU_UXVN_Y

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) SUUP → __S__TUV / TR__U__W / U__U__UX / VN__P__Y

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All spoons are forks.

All forks are knives.

No knife is a spatula.

Conclusions:

I. Some knives are spoons.

II. No fork is a spatula.

III. Some spoons are spatulas.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
**Statements:**

All spoons are forks.

All forks are knives.

No knife is a spatula.

The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e8243d2d65f9ee77dac3c83b4c260696bc3490288a5216c9b8c3df866552369.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some knives are spoons. - **True **(because All spoons are forks, and All forks are knives. So, Some knives are spoons too)

II. No fork is a spatula. - **True **(because All forks are knives and No knife is a spatula. So, No fork is a spatula it is true)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusions I and II follow".**

questions.question:
Select the triad in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the given triads.

(8, 9, 7), (24, 13, 35)

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent

digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1

and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (2nd number + 3rd number) ÷ 2 = 1st number.

Now,

For (8, 9, 7):

⇒ (9 + 7) ÷ 2

⇒ 16 ÷ 2 = 8.

For (24, 13, 35):

⇒ (13 + 35) ÷ 2

⇒ 48 ÷ 2 = 24.

Similarly, for **(17, 11, 23):**

**⇒ (11 + 23) ÷ 2 **

**⇒ 34 ÷ 2 = 17.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: 61 is related to 18 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 213 is related to 38. To which of the following is 509 related, following the same logic? (NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/deleting/multiplying etc., to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is:

**Logic: n³ - 3 & n² + 2**

Now,

61 is related to 18

→ 4³ - 3 = 64 - 3 = 61,

→ 4² + 2 = 16 + 2 = 18.

213 is related to 38

→ 63 - 3 = 216 - 3 = 213,

→ 62 + 2 = 36 + 2 = 38.

Similarly, for **509**

**→ 83 - 3 = 512 - 3 = 509,**

**→ 82 + 2 = 64 + 2 = 66.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
